summary: Today we are opening consultation on the next phase of our deregulation agenda to boost productivity and competition in the financial sector. summary: The Albanese Government is today introducing legislation to better incentivise innovation and investment and grow our economy. title: New inflation figures
summary: New figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics show that inflation ticked up in September. title: Reserve Bank interest rate decision
summary: Today the Reserve Bank increased the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85 per cent. Today’s decision was widely expected but that doesn’t make it any easier for Australian families and businesses to absorb. summary: The Albanese Government has reappointed Mr Bruce Miller AO as part‑time Chair of the Foreign Investment Review Board (FIRB) and appointed Ms Carolyn Kay as part‑time Deputy Chair, as part of her reappointment to the FIRB. summary: The Albanese Government is hosting a delegation of nine of the United Kingdom’s major investors to showcase Australia as an attractive investment destination. summary: The Albanese Government is making targeted reforms to the superannuation performance test to deliver better retirement outcomes for Australians. summary: New data released by the ABS today shows that nominal wage growth picked up, driven by the Government’s support for higher wages.
